div.head: Duns 2.1
div.ab: Non stat alia lada (id est purgatio) de tihla (id est compellatione) nisi ordalium inter Walos et Anglos – nisi pati uoluerint.
Ne stent nan oðer lad æt tihtlan bute ordal betweox Wealan ⁊ Ænglan, bute man ðafian wille.
Kein anderer Reinigungsbeweis als das Ordal gilt bei einer Klage zwischen Wallisern und Engländern, es sei denn, man [Gegner] wolle [leichteren] zulassen.
No other clearing proof than the ordeal holds in an accusation between Welsh and English, unless one [the opponent] is willing to allow [a lighter one].
Upon accusation, no other exculpation between the English and Welsh is valid except the ordeal, unless one [of the opponents] wants to admit it [the falsity of his claim].
